label: Serial Bridge
description: Real hardware I/O over Web Serial. Connects to GRBL/Arduino/stepper-controller style devices over USB-serial, sends raw or G-code lines, streams incoming telemetry to the bus, and can be wired (via the wire system) so any mod's output — sequencer steps, XY pad, LFO — drives a physical device. Requires a Chromium-based browser (Web Serial is not implemented in Firefox or Safari) and a user gesture to grant port access.

constraints: Chromium-based browsers only (Chrome, Edge, Opera) — Web Serial has no Firefox/Safari implementation.
Requires a direct user click to call navigator.serial.requestPort() — cannot be triggered programmatically.
Runs over a secure context; file:// origins are treated as secure by Chromium so the packaged shell works, but confirm on the target browser version.
